name: nessy-desktop
description: Desktop AI agent client for T-Bank workflows

scripts.test:isolated: n=$(find . -name '*.isolated.ts' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.references/*' -not -path './release/*' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "test:isolated: $n suite file(s)"; if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'test:isolated: zero suites found - a green run over nothing is not a gate, refusing'; exit 1; fi; for f in $(find . -name '*.isolated.ts' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.references/*' -not -path './release/*'); do echo "test:isolated: running $f"; bun test "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck:chain: bun run typecheck:coverage && bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:server-core && bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:session-tools-core && bun run typecheck:session-mcp-server && bun run typecheck:codex-responses-adapter && bun run typecheck:codex-agent-server && bun run typecheck:pi-agent-server && bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:electron && bun run typecheck:ui && bun run typecheck:viewer && bun run typecheck:webui && bun run typecheck:build-scripts && bun run typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:build-scripts: cd scripts/build && bun run tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:scripts: bun run tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && bun run tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.ipc-inventory.json && bun run tsc -p scripts/cdp/tsconfig.json
scripts.server:dev: bun run server:build:subprocess && NESSY_DEBUG=true NESSY_BUNDLED_ASSETS_ROOT=$PWD/apps/electron bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.test:shared:all: bun run test:shared:llm-connections && bun run test:shared:models-pi && bun run test:shared:config && bun run test:shared:codex-adapter
scripts.validate:dev: bun run typecheck:all && bun run test:shared:all && bun run test:doc-tools
scripts.validate:ci:chain: bun run lint:i18n:parity && bun run lint:i18n:sorted && bun run lint && bun run ipc:inventory:check && bun run check:coverage-map && bun run validate:dev
scripts.lint:chain: bun run lint:coverage && bun run lint:nul-bytes && bun run lint:settings-line-citations && bun run lint:comment-globs && bun run lint:conditional-expect && bun run lint:matcher-mutation && bun run lint:minified-citations && bun run lint:exports-map && bun run lint:ledger-citations && bun run lint:denominator-twin && bun run lint:module-graph-hooks && bun run lint:mock-module-spread && bun run lint:shape-pointer-reasons && bun run lint:mcp-connect-seam && bun run lint:dropped-log-sink && bun run lint:i18n:reachable && bun run lint:dp-auth-codes-table && bun run lint:surface:live && bun run lint:electron && bun run lint:shared && bun run lint:server-core && bun run lint:ui && bun run lint:scripts && bun run lint:cli && bun run lint:viewer && bun run lint:webui && bun run lint:codex-agent-server && bun run lint:codex-protocol && bun run lint:codex-responses-adapter && bun run lint:core && bun run lint:pi-agent-server && bun run lint:server && bun run lint:session-mcp-server && bun run lint:session-tools-core && bun run lint:generator-self-test && bun run lint:plan-shas && bun run lint:workspace-shadowing && bun run lint:native-binary-install && bun run lint:source-text-windows && bun run lint:braced-region-controls && bun run lint:headless-stdout-writes && bun run lint:wire-exact-lists && bun run lint:docs-site-build && bun run lint:i18n:coverage && bun run lint:plan-verdicts
scripts.electron:build: bun run electron:build:main && bun run electron:build:servers && bun run electron:build:preload && bun run electron:build:renderer && bun run electron:build:resources && bun run electron:build:assets
scripts.electron:dev:logs: pgrep -f 'tail -f.*Nessy Desktop/main.log' > /dev/null || osascript -e "tell application \"Terminal\" to do script \"$PWD/scripts/tail-electron-logs.sh\""
scripts.electron:dist: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.electron:dist:win: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:dist:linux: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.electron:dist:dev:mac: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NESSY_DEV_RUNTIME=1 bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.electron:dist:dev:win: NESSY_DEV_RUNTIME=1 bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:dist:dev:linux: NESSY_DEV_RUNTIME=1 bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.playground:dev: lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/electron/vite.config.ts --open /playground.html
scripts.viewer:dev: lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/viewer/vite.config.ts --open /s/tz5-13I84pwK_he
scripts.webui:dev: lsof -ti:5175 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; vite dev --config apps/webui/vite.config.ts
scripts.server:build:subprocess: cd packages/session-mcp-server && bun run build && cd ../pi-agent-server && bun run build
scripts.server:prod: bun run server:build:subprocess && bun run webui:build && NESSY_WEBUI_DIR=apps/webui/dist NESSY_BUNDLED_ASSETS_ROOT=$PWD/apps/electron bun run packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.server:dev:webui: bun run server:build:subprocess && bun run webui:build && NESSY_WEBUI_DIR=apps/webui/dist NESSY_WEBUI_PORT=3100 bun run server:dev
